title: Chat about McGee, a tavern and old photographs
summary: Brief talk about places where Artigues and the interviewers heard each other, a photographer, and Johnny McGee.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I haven't heard him in a long time. I didn't know I used to hear him. That is nice. What was it, Magazine in Peniston? Yeah, he used to play up there, that's right.
Charlie's Tavern or something I think. Something damn fun though.
They changed it to the Elm Bowl Room. They keep changing the name of that place.
I saw you up there one night. Yeah.
We took some pictures, remember? Yeah. And all that, uh, Ralston Crawford, the red-faced photographer. From New York. Yeah.
I was playing with, that was, uh, McGee's man up there.
Is Johnny in the Union now? I don't know.
I haven't seen Johnny in, oh God knows when, Dick.

I saw him a few months ago. He was at Tulane. I didn't know what the hell he was. He's a fine boy. He is. Uh, when you started out on trumpet, did you sit in any before you ever began to come professional?
